# FEN — Freelance Web Designer & Developer

> FEN is a Vietnamese freelance web designer and developer with 4+ years of experience building premium websites across 32+ projects. Based in Vietnam, working worldwide. Specializes in dark luxury interfaces, editorial design systems, and full front-end development. Available for new projects.

## Services

- Web Design (UI/UX, visual systems, Figma prototyping)
- Front-end Development (React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GSAP)
- Creative Direction (art direction, brand visual strategy)
- Landing Page Design & Development (conversion-optimized)
- Portfolio Website Design (creative professionals, studios)
- E-commerce Website Design (Shopify, custom builds)
- Healthcare Website Design (clinics, spas, wellness)
- Education Platform Design (LMS, course websites, schools)
- Corporate & Business Website Design
- Motion & Interaction Design (GSAP animations, micro-interactions)

## Technical Skills

- **Languages:** HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES2024), TypeScript
- **Frameworks:** React 18, Vite 5, Next.js
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS, Vanilla CSS, CSS Variables, CSS Grid/Flexbox
- **Animation:** GSAP 3, ScrollTrigger, Framer Motion
- **Design:** Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator
- **Deployment:** Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages

## About

FEN handles every stage of web production independently: from initial concept and wireframing through visual design in Figma, to front-end development and deployment. This end-to-end approach means clients work with one person throughout — with a single consistent creative vision from start to finish.

Design philosophy: premium visual quality, strong typographic hierarchy, intentional negative space, subtle motion, and fast-loading pages that respect the user's attention.

Sometimes spending three hours fixing something that is only four pixels out of place.
